description: This file defines a GUI dialog class 'addModifierDialog' for managing modifiers in the BORIS behavioral observation software. It includes methods for adding, removing, sorting, and editing modifier sets and individual modifiers, as well as loading modifiers from files. The class interacts with UI components and handles user actions related to modifier management.

classes.name: addModifierDialog
classes.description: A QDialog subclass providing a user interface for managing modifier sets and individual modifiers within the BORIS software.

methods.name: pb_pushed
methods.description: Handles the OK or Cancel button presses, with a warning if the modifier text field is not empty.

methods.name: add_subjects
methods.description: Adds subjects as modifiers to the current set.

methods.name: add_modifiers_from_file
methods.description: Loads modifiers from a selected file and adds them to the current list, with validation.

methods.name: sort_modifiers
methods.description: Sorts the list of modifiers alphabetically.

methods.name: set_name_changed
methods.description: Updates the current modifier set's name based on user input.

methods.name: set_description_changed
methods.description: Updates the current modifier set's description based on user input.

methods.name: type_changed
methods.description: Updates the current modifier set's type and enables/disables related UI components.

methods.name: moveSetLeft
methods.description: Moves the selected modifier set one position to the left.

methods.name: moveSetRight
methods.description: Moves the selected modifier set one position to the right.

methods.name: moveModifierUp
methods.description: Moves the selected modifier up in the list.

methods.name: moveModifierDown
methods.description: Moves the selected modifier down in the list.

methods.name: add_set_of_modifiers
methods.description: Adds a new modifier set, creating UI components and updating internal data.

methods.name: remove_set_of_modifiers
methods.description: Removes the current modifier set after user confirmation, updating UI and internal data.

methods.name: modifyModifier
methods.description: Prepares the selected modifier for editing by populating input fields and removing it from the list.

methods.name: removeModifier
methods.description: Removes the selected modifier from the current set.

methods.name: addModifier
methods.description: Adds a new modifier to the current set after validation, updating UI and internal data.

methods.name: tabWidgetModifiersSets_changed
methods.description: Handles user switching between modifier sets, with prompts if current input is unsaved.

methods.name: get_modifiers
methods.description: Returns the current modifier sets and modifiers as a JSON string, cleaning up empty or invalid entries.
